blocks.text: Cebu’s waters became an arena of synchronized strokes as 43 teams from Cebu and beyond converged for the second edition of the NUSTAR Dragon Boat Regatta, on September 19, 2026. With more than 1,300 paddlers up for the challenge, the premier destination’s waterfront became a gathering point for wellness, advocacy, and inclusion. “We are not just promoting Cebu, we are really promoting the sport… We want to create the best venue for Dragon Boat and make the Philippines be known as a big Dragon Boat destination,” cites Kamae De Jesus, the NUSTAR Resort’s Vice President for Business Development.
